_meta.description: Fintech-specific product metrics — neobanks, payment apps, lending, investment platforms.

metrics.name: KYC Completion Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of users who started KYC and successfully completed it. Primary activation gate in any regulated fintech. Drop here = compliance friction.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{end_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{start_event}' THEN {user_col} END), 0), 1) AS kyc_completion_rate_pct FROM {table}

metrics.name: Payment Success Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of initiated payments that complete successfully. Core reliability metric. Below 95% indicates infrastructure or UX issues.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{end_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{start_event}' THEN {user_col} END), 0), 1) AS payment_success_rate_pct FROM {table}

metrics.name: First Transaction Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of all users who have completed at least one transaction. Key activation milestone — users who transact once are far more likely to stay.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{matched_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}), 0), 1) AS first_txn_rate_pct FROM {table}

metrics.name: Average Transaction Value
metrics.description_hint: Mean value per transaction. Segment by user cohort or product category to find high-value use cases worth doubling down on.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG({numeric_col}), 2) AS avg_txn_value FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' AND {numeric_col} > 0

metrics.name: Average Revenue Per User (ARPU)
metrics.description_hint: Total transaction value divided by active users. Key monetisation health metric. Low ARPU with high DAU = engagement without revenue.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(SUM({numeric_col}) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}), 0), 2) AS arpu FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' AND {numeric_col} > 0

metrics.name: Transactions Per Active User
metrics.description_hint: Average number of transactions per active user per month. Measures depth of usage — high-frequency users are your best retention cohort.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}), 0), 2) AS txns_per_user FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' AND DATE({time_col}) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

metrics.name: Loan Application Conversion Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of users who started a loan application and received approval. Tracks credit underwriting funnel quality.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{end_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{start_event}' THEN {user_col} END), 0), 1) AS loan_conversion_rate_pct FROM {table}

metrics.name: Investment Feature Adoption
metrics.description_hint: % of active users who have used any investment feature (mutual funds, stocks, gold, etc.). Cross-sell indicator — invested users have 3-5x higher LTV.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{matched_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}), 0), 1) AS investment_adoption_pct FROM {table}
